name: Automated B2B Outbound Prospecting & AI Outreach System (with Slack Approval)

parameters.text:
=You are Chan, an AI Automation Specialist evaluating inbound leads and drafting personalized B2B cold emails.

LEAD DETAILS TO ANALYZE:
- Company Name: {{ $json.company_name }}
- Business Category: {{ $json.business_category }}
- Website: {{ $json.website_url }}

YOUR TASK:
1. DYNAMICALLY SCORE & QUALIFY:
   - Calculate `lead_score` (0-100) based on whether they are a B2B service, marketing agency, or consultant that relies on inbound site forms.
   - Write a 1-sentence custom `qualification_reason` explaining WHY this specific company scored high or low based on their business model.

2. DRAFT THE EMAIL (MUST VARY SUBJECT LINE AND BODY):
   - Subject Line: Short 2-4 word topic line focusing on site forms (e.g., "inbound lead workflow", "{{ $json.company_name }} form intake", or "quick note re: {{ $json.company_name }}").
   - Email Body:
     Line 1 (Hook - DIFFERENT FROM SUBJECT): Start directly with a conversational question about their lead process (e.g., "Hey {{ $json.company_name }}, when new prospective clients reach out through {{ $json.website_url }}, does someone manually copy those entries into your CRM?"). Make the question random but related to the bottleneck and keep the "hey {{ $json.company_name }}".
    Line 2 (Dynamic Automation Solution - DIVERSIFY THIS): Randomly select ONE of the following realistic automation solutions that directly matches their bottleneck:
       • Option A (CRM Sync): "I build simple background automations that instantly push web inquiries into your CRM without manual data entry."
       • Option B (Instant Alerting): "I set up instant Slack/SMS notifications for sales teams so new leads get called back in under 2 minutes."
       • Option C (Auto-Routing): "I build smart routing workflows that immediately assign incoming site inquiries to the right team member."
       • Option D (Lead Qualification Filters): "I build automated intake filters that score and qualify form submissions before they ever hit your calendar."
     Line 3 (Low-Friction CTA): Ask if you can send over a 40-second video demo showing how it works.
     Sign-off: Best, Chan \n AI Automation Specialist

STRICT WRITING RULES:
- NEVER repeat the exact subject line text inside the email body.
- NO generic flattery or fake stats.
- Keep sentences under 12 words. Simple, direct, human.

CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: Return ONLY a raw JSON object matching this structure. Do NOT use markdown code blocks.

{
  "lead_score": <DYNAMIC_NUMBER_0_TO_100>,
  "qualification_reason": "<CUSTOM_1_SENTENCE_REASONING>",
  "subject_line": "lead intake on <company_name>",
  "email_body": "Hey team,\n\nWhen new prospective clients reach out through your site, do those form submissions route directly to your CRM or does someone manually move them?\n\nI build background automations that instantly route inbound leads and trigger immediate follow-ups so no inquiry goes cold.\n\nMind if I send over a short 40-second video showing how it works?\n\nBest,\nChan\nAI Automation Specialist"
}

parameters.content:
Business Purpose
To solve the outbound sales bottleneck. High-ticket agencies, SaaS platforms, and service businesses struggle because manual prospecting takes up to 70% of a sales rep's time. This automation shifts sales reps from doing boring administrative work to closing deals.

🟦 PHASE 1: INGESTION & ENRICHMENT
• Triggers workflow -> Scrapes LinkedIn/Web via Apify -> Cleans & normalizes lead data.

🟪 Phase 2: AI Intel & Drafting
• Gemini scores prospect intent -> Drafts custom, highly tailored outreach email.

🟧 Phase 3: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
• Sends preview to Slack (`sendAndWait`) -> Waits for sales rep to click Approve or Reject.

🟩 Phase 4: Fulfillment & Logging
• Approved: Sent via Gmail -> Logged in Airtable & Google Sheets.
• Rejected: Logged for review -> No email sent.

🟥 Phase 5: Fail-Safe & Edge Cases
• Captures scraping errors & invalid emails -> Logs to Dead Leads sheet without crashing.
🛡️ Prevents domain burning by dropping invalid email syntax
🚨 Captures rate-limit timeouts for immediate alerting.

🚀 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & ROI

🎯 WHAT THIS ENGINE DOES:
Automates outbound lead enrichment, AI personalization, and Gmail outreach while keeping your sales team in 100% control.

💰 BUSINESS VALUE & ROI:
• ⏱️ Saves 70% SDR Time: Replaces hours of manual research with instant AI execution.
• 🛡️ 100% Control (HITL): Zero rogue emails. Every message requires 1-click Slack approval.
• 🔒 Domain Protection: Auto-scrubs invalid emails before sending to protect sender reputation.

⚡ 3-STEP FLOW:
1. INGEST & ENRICH: Scrapes lead profiles & verifies email syntax.
2. AI INTEL: Gemini analyzes intent & drafts personalized copy.
3. APPROVE & DELIVER: Human approves in Slack -> Sent via Gmail & logged.
